content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Researchers have characterised industrial sludge and wastewater over seasonal cycles using multiple analytical techniques including XRD, FTIR, SEM-EDS, and ICP-OES to identify compositional and phase variation.","sources":[{"id":"R0105","field":"bio","quote":"The group regularly uses XRD, FTIR, SEM-EDS, BET surface analysis, and ICP-OES"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-01391","field":"abstract","quote":"Sludge samples collected over twelve months from the neutralisation basin of an anodising plant in Vojvodina were characterised by ICP-OES, XRD, FTIR"}]},{"text":"Coagulation and flocculation chemistry has been applied to treat wastewater containing organic contaminants, achieving organic carbon and colour reduction through controlled addition of aluminium-based coagulants.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-01393","field":"abstract","quote":"Coagulation–flocculation jar tests were performed on a synthetic reactive-blue dye solution"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-01393","field":"abstract","quote":"COD reduction in the municipal effluent was 61% at the same dose"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has strong capabilities in wastewater characterisation and coagulation chemistry [R0105, SYN-PUB-01393], but published work focuses on chemical treatment and nutrient recovery rather than membrane fouling mechanisms, biofilm formation, or pre-treatment strategies specific to dairy wastewater fats and proteins."}
